method: Wednesday spread-based upset screen plus exact-price governance

coverage.price_policy: Exact moneylines never inferred from spreads.

criteria.name: market-underdog-profile
criteria.evidence: New York Jets is 9.5 points from the current spread favorite.

criteria.name: structural-resistance
criteria.evidence: Current structural lean NYJ; structural fair Kansas City Chiefs -6.1.

criteria.name: prior-quality-gap
criteria.evidence: Preseason prior -6.50 vs opponent 2.64.

criteria.name: recent-form
criteria.evidence: Prior-week scoring margin -5.

criteria.name: availability
criteria.evidence: Final injury/inactive status is not assumed on Wednesday morning; late availability is an execution veto.

candidates.analysis: Upset/underdog research completed from spread, frozen model and prior-week state. Observed exact moneyline 400 via ESPN DraftKings; threshold qualification is separate from recommendation.
